mintAuthority.summary: DAI has an economically unbounded governance issuance path: the Sky Pause Proxy is a Vat ward and can create unbacked Vat.dai with Vat.suck, then convert that credit into durable ERC-20 DAI through DaiJoin.exit without new collateral. The current Chief/Pause route requires 48 hours after plotting, but the complete 129-ward Vat liability inventory and delegated/emergency paths are not execution-certified, so no governed-issuance credit is claimed.

review.evidence: D14/D29 reviewed 2026-10-03 at Ethereum block 26112822, hash 0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a. The prior pinned read-only Vat.suck simulation from Pause Proxy succeeded; verified suck creates unbacked internal credit with no collateral or debt-ceiling test, and DaiJoin.exit converts credit into durable DAI to a chosen recipient. The former raiseable economic-cap verdict is therefore corrected to unbounded. Reconciliation and supervision remain not-applicable/none, so incomplete governed evidence derives unbounded-unreconciled, not compromise. Full-history Vat rely/deny DSNote census returned 158 logs and 144 distinct candidate wards; every latest event agreed with a pinned wards read, including the revoked constructor deployer. There are 129 live wards: 61 collateral joins, 47 clippers and 21 other modules. All 129 have verified source responses; 128 deployed runtimes matched exactly, while CRVV1ETHSTETH Clipper 0x1926862f899410bfc19fefb8a3c69c7aed22463a has an empty deployed-bytecode field and remains unbound. D29 is not certified: all 129 ward execution surfaces, including Pot/Jug drip, D3M exec/uncull, DAI/USDS vesting, Teleport, STUSDS, Lockstake, Kicker/Flopper, Auto-Line and LineMom, lack complete reachable-authority/liability scopes. End.snip/skip call suck and ESM emergency authority is not certified restriction-only. Vow downstream accounting, LitePSM.fill with synthetic ink, Allocator draw and Spark ALM mintUSDS relayers also lack complete ceiling/admin/bypass closure. The immediate public DaiJoin exit cannot assert the governor as its sole execution root. Chief approval weight is escrowed SKY, not live wallet balance; it has no fixed vote duration and the proven governor path has only the enforced 48-hour Pause. The exact live ward census and per-path blocking gaps are retained in the U2SkyGoverned research result; authored scopes intentionally remain partial.
